evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Visual graph reasoning requires answering graph-theoretic questions directly from graph images, where graph topology and state are conveyed visually rather than given in symbolic form.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Experiments on three benchmarks GVLQA, VisionGraph, and VGCURE, show that Qwen-VGCompiler, built on an 8B backbone, surpasses the strongest closed-source VLM baseline by 28.9% and the strongest code-based baseline by 23.7%, while maintaining high efficiency.
